source: Xu & Norell 2006, Geological Journal 41: 419-437, Fig. 3: simplified cladogram of coelurosaurs from the Jehol Group; rectangular, root left, tips right, no node markers. Image: census figure (1001x1607 px), a page render of the image area.
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names, including collapsed groups ('Other Dromaeosauridae', 'Other Troodontidae', Oviraptoridae, Ornithothoraces, ...)
gold_note: Coelurosaurian summary cladogram, fully resolved. Read by eye. 28 tips, fully resolved. Random-sample case (seed 20261114). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
